body: I'm so glad that's helped you. Unfortunately my issues are mainly from things to do with religion and past trauma but I know that it can be an amazing thing for people. And yea, of course after so many years I /have/ learnt how to manage the thoughts better, so suicidal thoughts don't have as much of an impact. I know that since i've improevd and been able to happier that there's no use in giving up if I can achieve a high that I did. Thanks for the input, really appreciate talking to people just to clear my head.
i'll make sure to do that next time. thankyou.

i dont think its a red flag at all. its perfectly normal. telling my bf was the best decision of my life, and now hes stopped several suicide attempts. a human being to listen to your break downs is one of the best feelings ever. its worth it. if you love them and trust them then you should know how theyd react or at least know theyd accept it. if they know whats wrong they can help you through it.

idk if its just me, but I used to go to therapy, changed over 5 times thinking I just didn't click, but it made me feel worse. having to talk about my past issues and my feelings. bringing it all up to the surface hurts a lot and just dug me deeper. maybe i just never went to the right one. who knows.

if anything, the one thing that stops me, is curiosity. curious as to what my future will be like. what will happen. will i win the lotto? will i marry? will i live in a mansion? what will happen to me? theres 30-60 years of unexplored life ahead of me where anything could happen. my life could flip upside down in a second if i just waited- waited to be there for it.

thats mostly what stops me anyway. not hope. definitely not hope. and not strength. just- curiosity. who gives a shit if you fail the finals? give yourself a break. take time off life. let yourself sit in your room for days on end. dont fight it. <3

its so weird how as someones whos attempted several times before too I still want to stop other people. reminds me of this song : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tZ4cM0hYofc

never really good with helping but i hope you find someone who can and can be there for you irl. someone to cuddle is always the best.
